_comment: S2380 - the run matrix of the automated phone UI sweep, as data rather than as code.
Strategic 5.1: orientation, screen profile, colour theme and language are each a dimension that
expands by editing this file; the walker reads it and never hardcodes a value.
The walker nests the dimensions outermost-first IN THE ORDER DECLARED under `dimensions`, which
is the order of switching cost (step 04.1): the profile is outermost because switching it means
booting a different emulator; the language is next because a per-app locale switch recreates the
activity; theme and orientation are cheap - the debug hook applies a theme inside the running
process and a rotation is one settings write - so they change most often. Expensive dimensions
thus change least often (strategic 5.1).
profile values are ids from ui-sweep-profiles.json - the same declaration the bench asserts
against, so the walker and the bench cannot disagree about what `small-phone` means.
language values carry the per-app locale tag fed to `cmd locale set-app-locales` (the API 33+
shell path strategic 3.2 pins) and the resource folder whose strings.xml the walker resolves
@string/ labels and expectRes markers from. `values` is the default (English) folder.
theme values are the nine raw spellings ThemeTestHooks accepts; anything else is answered with
ACK_REJECTED and the walker refuses the combination rather than photographing the wrong theme.
orientation values carry the `settings put system user_rotation` value. Accelerometer rotation is
switched off for the run so the value actually holds.
subsets declare a shortened run (strategic 3.1): a key missing from a subset means ALL values of
that dimension. `quick` is one language, one theme, one bench - the fast check the owner asked
for; `ru-dark` is the middle slice that exercises the second language and a dark theme on both
benches without paying for nine themes.
seedRoot is the device directory ui-sweep-seed.ps1 filled; setup-add-local-resource in
ui-sweep-screens.json picks it through the system folder picker. `package` is the debug id the
sweep drives and that the theme hook answers on.
Consumed by scripts/devtest/ui-sweep-walk.ps1.

dimensions.switchCost: a different emulator must boot - outermost
a per-app locale switch recreates the activity
the debug hook applies it inside the running process
one rotation setting on the live display - innermost
